home.banhmiDescription: Bánh mì is a Vietnamese baguette with a crisp crust and a soft, airy centre. Filled with savoury ingredients, it makes a satisfying meal.
home.phoDescription: Phở is a Vietnamese soup enjoyed at home, at street stalls and in restaurants throughout the country. It is one of Vietnam’s best known dishes.
home.ownerDescription1: Kim Huong Nguyen opened Saigon Sandwich Bakery in Turku to share the flavours of Vietnam. The restaurant has received a warm welcome from its customers.
home.ownerDescription2: I started developing recipes because I wanted people in Finland to discover Vietnamese flavours.

about.title: About us
about.description1: Saigon Sandwich Bakery began in 2018, when Kim Huong Nguyen opened a Vietnamese street food stall in Turku’s market hall. Customers welcomed it warmly from the start. Her aim was to share the flavours of Vietnam. In the early days, she also set up a stall on Puistokatu.
about.description2: The French introduced white bread to Vietnam, where it became the basis for bánh mì with Vietnamese fillings. For Kim Huong Nguyen, a good baguette should be crisp outside and soft inside. She spent three years developing her recipe to bring the texture of Saigon’s street food to Turku.
about.description3: At Turku’s market hall, Saigon Sandwich sells around a hundred sandwiches a day. Fillings include chicken, pork, beef, seitan and soy.
about.founder.description: Kim Huong Nguyen oversees the food at Saigon Sandwich Bakery, from choosing ingredients to developing recipes and preparing each dish. She brings care and attention to both flavour and presentation.
about.staff.description: Thuy Tien Nguyen welcomes customers with friendly service. She helps with menu choices, answers questions and makes each visit a pleasant one.
feedback.title: What our customers say
feedback.customers1: Really tasty sandwiches at a very reasonable price. The restaurant is near the edge of the city centre, with a small, cosy interior. The service was very friendly!
feedback.customers2: Crisp baguettes and perfect fillings. I could eat them every day! Try the Vietnamese iced coffee too. ❤
feedback.customers3: Great sandwiches with just the right amount of heat and spice. You can ask for them just the way you like. Be prepared to wait if there’s a queue.
feedback.customers4: I’ve been coming almost every day since I found this place. If you want authentic Vietnamese food, give it a try. I love the bánh mì and fresh bread. I’m on my way there right now!
feedback.customers5: Excellent bánh mì, delicious flavours and friendly staff. Never disappoints. Highly recommended!
